title: alint agent report (v1)
description: Output schema emitted by `alint check --format agent`. Optimised for AI coding agents that consume alint inside their own self-correction loops. Differs from `--format json` by (1) flattening rule-results into a single `violations` array, (2) adding a templated `agent_instruction` per violation, and (3) reporting `severity` as a lowercase string rather than the SARIF mapping. The format is stable behind `schema_version: 1`; field additions are non-breaking, removals or semantic changes bump the version.

schema_version.description: Report schema version. Always 1 for this schema.

format.description: Format discriminator. Always the literal string "agent" for this schema; lets a multi-format consumer route on a single field.

fixable_violations.description: Subset of total_violations whose source rule declares an autofix; an agent can use this to decide whether to suggest `alint fix`.

severity.description: Lowercase severity string. `off` rules don't produce violations and never appear here.

rule_id.description: Rule id, matches the `id:` field of a rule in the config.

file.description: Repo-relative path; absent for tree-wide violations.

human_message.description: The rule's violation message verbatim, suitable for human review. Mirror of `message` in `--format json`.

agent_instruction.description: Templated remediation phrasing optimised for an LLM to act on. Composed from severity, message, location, fix availability, and policy URL.

fix_available.description: True when the source rule declares an autofix. Mirrors `fix_available: true` callout in `agent_instruction`.

policy_url.description: Optional documentation URL provided by the rule.
